name: The Problem With Prideclaws

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking and culling predators near settlements is familiar work. Prideclaws in these numbers still demand respect.

faq.answer: Prideclaws are fierce predators of the hills and highlands of Shen'dar. Their pelts are valuable, and their growing numbers bring them closer to settlements.
Prideclaws roam the hills of the Shen'dar Highlands. Their growing numbers carry them toward the local village and its inhabitants.
Bandits and mad cultists already menace the region. As prideclaw numbers grow, the beasts draw near the village, putting children and domestic animals at risk.
faq.q: Why does the village need the prideclaws culled?

faq.answer: Village crafters use prideclaw pelts to make practical goods and supplies.
faq.q: What will be done with the prideclaw pelts?

faq.answer: Roaming bandits and unstable cultists trouble the hills around the settlement, alongside the wild prideclaws.
faq.q: What other threats plague the surrounding hills?

aliases: who gives the problem with prideclaws
faq.answer: The villager overseeing the culling finds prideclaws somewhat cute, even from behind armed guards. Still, keeping the village safe matters before tragedy strikes.
faq.q: How do the locals view the prideclaws?

sections.body: Prideclaws are pressing toward the village in the Shen'dar Highlands. Bandits roam the hills, and unhinged cultists trouble the region. Villagers face danger from several sides. As the beasts grow bolder and their territory spreads, the settlement draws nearer to their reach.
sections.title: A Growing Wild Menace

sections.body: Villagers have organized a culling before the wandering predators can snatch pets or children. Driving prideclaws back from the borders helps guard the settlement. Their sturdy pelts also give village craftsmen material for useful goods.
sections.title: Securing the Borders

summary: The Shen'dar Highlands village faces danger from prideclaws, bandits, and cultists. The beasts press toward the settlement, and culling them guards the people while providing useful pelts.
